AddClientToBlackList.title: AddClientToBlackList
AddClientToBlackList.summary: Adds a client to the blacklist of a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system and revokes the write access from the client. The blacklist serves as an I/O fence.

ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: Apply an automatic snapshot policy to file systems
ApplyAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Applies an automatic snapshot policy to one or more file systems.

ApplyDataFlowAutoRefresh.title: Add auto-refresh configuration for a data flow
ApplyDataFlowAutoRefresh.summary: Configures automatic updates for a specified data flow.

AttachVscToFilesystems.title: Associate a VSC device with a file system
AttachVscToFilesystems.summary: Associates a Virtual Storage Channel (VSC) device with a file system.

CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: Cancel the automatic snapshot policy for one or more file systems
CancelAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: Cancels the automatic snapshot policy that has been created for a file system.

CancelDataFlowAutoRefresh.title: CancelDataFlowAutoRefresh
CancelDataFlowAutoRefresh.summary: Cancels the AutoRefresh configuration for a dataflow.

CancelDataFlowSubTask.title: Cancel a data flow streaming subtask
CancelDataFlowSubTask.summary: Cancels a data flow streaming subtask.

CancelDataFlowTask.title: Cancel a data flow task
CancelDataFlowTask.summary: Cancels a data flow batch task or streaming task that is in the Pending or Executing state.

CancelDirQuota.title: Cancel a directory quota for a file system
CancelDirQuota.summary: Cancels a directory quota for a file system.

CancelFilesetQuota.title: Cancel a fileset quota
CancelFilesetQuota.summary: Cancels the quota configured for a fileset.

CancelLifecycleRetrieveJob.title: CancelLifecycleRetrieveJob
CancelLifecycleRetrieveJob.summary: Cancels a running data retrieval task.

CancelRecycleBinJob.title: CancelRecycleBinJob
CancelRecycleBinJob.summary: Cancels a running job of the recycle bin.

ChangeResourceGroup.title: Change resource group
ChangeResourceGroup.summary: Changes the resource group to which a file system instance belongs.

CreateAccessRule.title: Create a permission rule
CreateAccessRule.summary: Creates a permission rule for a permission group.

CreateDataFlow.title: Create a data flow
CreateDataFlow.summary: Creates a data flow between a CPFS General-purpose or CPFS for Lingjun file system and source storage.

CreateDataFlowSubTask.title: Create a data flow streaming subtask
CreateDataFlowSubTask.summary: Creates a subtask for a data flow streaming task.

CreateDir.title: CreateDir
CreateDir.summary: Creates a directory in a file system.

CreateLogAnalysis.title: CreateLogAnalysis
CreateLogAnalysis.summary: Dumps the logs of a General-purpose NAS file system to Simple Log Service.

CreateProtocolMountTarget.title: Create a protocol service export directory
CreateProtocolMountTarget.summary: Creates an export directory for a protocol service.

CreateProtocolService.title: Create a protocol service
CreateProtocolService.summary: Creates a protocol service for a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system. The creation process takes approximately 5 to 10 minutes.

CreateRecycleBinDeleteJob.title: Permanently delete a file or directory from the recycle bin
CreateRecycleBinDeleteJob.summary: Creates a task to permanently delete a file or directory from the recycle bin.

CreateRecycleBinRestoreJob.title: CreateRecycleBinRestoreJob
CreateRecycleBinRestoreJob.summary: Restores a file or directory from the recycle bin.

DeleteAccessRule.title: Delete a permission rule
DeleteAccessRule.summary: Deletes a permission rule from a permission group.

DeleteLogAnalysis.title: DeleteLogAnalysis
DeleteLogAnalysis.summary: Disables log dumping for a General-purpose NAS file system.

DeleteProtocolMountTarget.title: DeleteProtocolMountTarget
DeleteProtocolMountTarget.summary: Deletes an export directory of a protocol service.

DeleteProtocolService.title: DeleteProtocolService
DeleteProtocolService.summary: Deletes a protocol service of a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system.

DeleteSnapshot.title: Delete a snapshot or cancel a snapshot creation task
DeleteSnapshot.summary: Deletes a specified snapshot or cancels a snapshot that is being created.

DescribeAccessPoint.title: Query access point details
DescribeAccessPoint.summary: Queries the details of an access point.

DescribeAccessRules.title: Query permission rule description
DescribeAccessRules.summary: Queries the description of a permission rule.

DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicies.title: Query created automatic snapshot policies
DescribeAutoSnapshotPolicies.summary: Queries the automatic snapshot policies that have been created.

DescribeAutoSnapshotTasks.title: Query automatic snapshot tasks
DescribeAutoSnapshotTasks.summary: Queries the list of automatic snapshot tasks.

DescribeBlackListClients.title: DescribeBlackListClients
DescribeBlackListClients.summary: Queries the status of clients in the blacklist of a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system.

DescribeDataFlowTasks.title: Query data flow tasks
DescribeDataFlowTasks.summary: Queries the details of data flow tasks.

DescribeDataFlows.title: Query data flows
DescribeDataFlows.summary: Queries data flow information of a CPFS file system.

DescribeDirQuotas.title: DescribeDirQuotas
DescribeDirQuotas.summary: Queries the directory quotas of a file system.

DescribeFileSystemStatistics.title: DescribeFileSystemStatistics
DescribeFileSystemStatistics.summary: Queries the statistics of file systems that are owned by the current account.

DescribeFilesets.title: Query fileset list
DescribeFilesets.summary: Queries the list of created filesets.

DescribeFilesystemsAssociatedHpnZones.title: DescribeFilesystemsAssociatedHpnZones
DescribeFilesystemsAssociatedHpnZones.summary: Retrieves the list of HpnZones for a file system. Access performance is optimal when compute nodes are located in one of the associated HpnZones.

DescribeFilesystemsVscAttachInfo.title: Query virtual storage channel information associated with a file system
DescribeFilesystemsVscAttachInfo.summary: Queries the virtual storage channel information associated with a file system.

DescribeLifecyclePolicies.title: Query lifecycle management policies
DescribeLifecyclePolicies.summary: Retrieves the list of lifecycle management policies.

DescribeLifecyclePolicyLogs.title: Query execution logs of a lifecycle management policy
DescribeLifecyclePolicyLogs.summary: Queries the execution logs of a lifecycle management policy. You can query logs from the last 90 days, with a maximum of 1000 log entries. Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported.

DescribeLogAnalysis.title: Retrieve log analysis information
DescribeLogAnalysis.summary: Lists the log analysis configurations in log analysis.

DescribeMountedClients.title: DescribeMountedClients
DescribeMountedClients.summary: Queries the clients on which a file system is mounted.

DescribeNfsAcl.title: DescribeNfsAcl
DescribeNfsAcl.summary: Queries whether the NFS ACL feature is enabled for a file system.

DescribeProtocolMountTarget.title: Query protocol service export directories
DescribeProtocolMountTarget.summary: Queries the export directories of a protocol service.

DescribeProtocolService.title: DescribeProtocolService
DescribeProtocolService.summary: Queries the information about protocol services.

DescribeRegions.title: Query regions
DescribeRegions.summary: Queries the available Alibaba Cloud regions.

DescribeSmbAcl.title: Query SMB AD ACL
DescribeSmbAcl.summary: Queries the SMB AD ACL feature.

DescribeSnapshots.title: Query snapshot list
DescribeSnapshots.summary: Queries information about one or more snapshots of a specified file system.

DescribeStoragePackages.title: DescribeStoragePackages
DescribeStoragePackages.summary: You can call the DescribeStoragePackages operation to query the list of storage plans.

DescribeZones.title: DescribeZones
DescribeZones.summary: Queries all zones in a region and the file system types that are supported in each zone.

DetachVscFromFilesystems.title: Dissociate a VSC device from a file system
DetachVscFromFilesystems.summary: Dissociates a VSC device from a file system.

DisableAndCleanRecycleBin.title: DisableAndCleanRecycleBin
DisableAndCleanRecycleBin.summary: Disables and empties the recycle bin of a General-purpose NAS file system.

DisableNfsAcl.title: DisableNfsAcl
DisableNfsAcl.summary: Disables the NFS ACL feature for a file system.

DisableSmbAcl.title: Disable SMB AD ACL
DisableSmbAcl.summary: Disables the SMB AD ACL feature.

EnableNfsAcl.title: EnableNfsAcl
EnableNfsAcl.summary: Enables the NFS ACL feature for a file system.

EnableRecycleBin.title: EnableRecycleBin
EnableRecycleBin.summary: Enables the recycle bin feature for a file system.

EnableSmbAcl.title: Enable SMB AD ACL
EnableSmbAcl.summary: Enables the SMB AD ACL feature.

GetDirectoryOrFileProperties.title: Query IA or archive file information
GetDirectoryOrFileProperties.summary: Queries whether a specified directory contains Infrequent Access (IA) storage class or Archive storage class files, or queries whether a specified file is an IA storage class or Archive storage class file.

GetFileset.title: GetFileset
GetFileset.summary: Queries the information about the created fileset.

GetProtocolMountTarget.title: GetProtocolMountTarget
GetProtocolMountTarget.summary: Query the export directory information of the protocol service

GetRecycleBinAttribute.title: Get recycle bin attributes
GetRecycleBinAttribute.summary: Queries the recycle bin configuration of a specified General-purpose NAS file system.

ListDirectoriesAndFiles.title: Query directory and file list
ListDirectoriesAndFiles.summary: Retrieves the list of IA storage class files and subdirectories that contain IA storage class files under a specified directory in a General-purpose NAS file system.

ListLifecycleRetrieveJobs.title: Query data retrieval task list
ListLifecycleRetrieveJobs.summary: Retrieves the list of created data retrieval tasks.

ListRecentlyRecycledDirectories.title: Query recently deleted directories
ListRecentlyRecycledDirectories.summary: Queries directories on which delete operations were recently performed.

ListRecycleBinJobs.title: Query tasks in the recycle bin
ListRecycleBinJobs.summary: Queries information about one or more tasks in the recycle bin.

ModifyAccessRule.title: Modify a permission group rule
ModifyAccessRule.summary: Modifies a permission rule in a permission group.

ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy.title: ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy
ModifyAutoSnapshotPolicy.summary: An automatic snapshot policy is modified. After you modify an automatic snapshot policy that is applied to a file system, the modification immediately applies to subsequent snapshots that are created for the file system.

ModifyDataFlow.title: Modify a data flow
ModifyDataFlow.summary: Modifies the attributes of a data flow.

ModifyDataFlowAutoRefresh.title: Modify dataflow automatic update configuration
ModifyDataFlowAutoRefresh.summary: Modifies the automatic update configuration of a dataflow.

ModifyFileSystem.title: Modify file system description
ModifyFileSystem.summary: Modifies the description of a file system.

ModifyProtocolMountTarget.title: ModifyProtocolMountTarget
ModifyProtocolMountTarget.summary: Modifies the export directory parameters of a protocol service. Only the description can be modified. The virtual private cloud (VPC) ID and vSwitch ID cannot be changed. To change these IDs, you must delete the export directory and create a new one.

ModifyProtocolService.title: ModifyProtocolService
ModifyProtocolService.summary: Modifies a protocol service. You can modify the description of a protocol service.

ModifySmbAcl.title: Update SMB AD ACL
ModifySmbAcl.summary: Updates the SMB AD ACL feature.

RemoveClientFromBlackList.title: RemoveClientFromBlackList
RemoveClientFromBlackList.summary: Remove the client from the blacklist.

ResetFileSystem.title: Roll back a file system to a specified snapshot
ResetFileSystem.summary: Rolls back a file system to the state of a specified historical snapshot.

RetryLifecycleRetrieveJob.title: RetryLifecycleRetrieveJob
RetryLifecycleRetrieveJob.summary: Retries failed a data retrieval task.

SetAgenticSpaceQuota.title: Set agenticSpace quota
SetAgenticSpaceQuota.summary: Sets the quota for an Agentic space.

SetDirQuota.title: Set a directory quota for a file system
SetDirQuota.summary: Sets a directory quota for a file system.

SetFilesetQuota.title: Set a fileset quota
SetFilesetQuota.summary: Sets a quota for a fileset.

StartLifecyclePolicyExecution.title: StartLifecyclePolicyExecution
StartLifecyclePolicyExecution.summary: Starts the execution of a lifecycle policy.

StopLifecyclePolicyExecution.title: Stop executing a lifecycle policy
StopLifecyclePolicyExecution.summary: Stops the execution of a lifecycle policy.

TagResources.title: TagResources
TagResources.summary: Creates tags and binds the tags to file systems.

UntagResources.title: UntagResources
UntagResources.summary: Removes tags from a file system.

UpdateLifecyclePolicy.title: Update the rules of a lifecycle management policy
UpdateLifecyclePolicy.summary:
Updates the rules of a lifecycle management policy. Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported.

UpdateLifecyclePolicy uses overwrite semantics. If an optional parameter is left empty, the corresponding field is deleted. To append lifecycle rules, first call the DescribeLifecyclePolicies operation to obtain the current lifecycle rule configurations, append the new lifecycle rule configurations, and then call the UpdateLifecyclePolicy operation to update the lifecycle rule configurations.

UpdateRecycleBinAttribute.title: UpdateRecycleBinAttribute
UpdateRecycleBinAttribute.summary: Modifies the retention period of data in the recycle bin of a file system.

UpgradeFileSystem.title: UpgradeFileSystem
UpgradeFileSystem.summary: Scales up an Extreme NAS file system or a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system.
